item.title: Wendy's Thin Mints Frosty returns with a new fusion
item.description: Wendy's has launched its Thin Mints Frosty nationwide, introducing a new "Fusion" variety and the returning "Swirl" version, in partnership with Girl Scouts of the USA, with local Girl Scout troops selling cookies at participating Wendy's locations.

item.title: Vilcek Foundation awards $50K prizes to immigrants in culinary arts
item.description: The Vilcek Foundation is offering six $50,000 cash awards to young immigrants in the US for outstanding early achievement in the culinary arts, with applications open until May 4, 2026.

item.title: Iconic Route 66 stop in Texas as ranks 4th best roadside attraction in U.S. study
item.description: Gatorland in Orlando is the most popular roadside attraction in the United States, according to a new study, followed by Sun Studio in Memphis, House on the Rock in Spring Green, and Cadillac Ranch in Amarillo.

item.title: Your couch ‘situationship’ could score you a free upgrade
item.description: The Lovesac Company and "Summer House" star Amanda Batula launched a Valentine's Day campaign, "UATIONSHIP", to encourage people to replace furniture that no longer meets their needs with products designed to last and evolve, while giving participants a chance to win a new Lovesac couch.

item.title: Freddy's offers $1 steakburgers for one day only
item.description: Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers will offer $1 Original Double steakburgers on February 24 exclusively to loyalty members who use the company's mobile app.

item.title: Dallas is 4th in U.S. for financial distress, says WalletHub
item.description: Dallas has been ranked as the fourth most financially distressed city in the US, with residents facing increasing pressure due to inflation and its impact on loan and credit payments.

item.title: Scarborough Renaissance Festival's 45th season starts April 2026
item.description: The 45th season of the Scarborough Renaissance Festival will take place from April 4 to May 25, featuring handcrafted shoppes, live entertainment, themed weekends, interactive attractions, and more.

item.title: Local students to screen films at Bankhead Film Festival
item.description: The 2nd Annual Bankhead Film Festival will be held on February 28th at the Plaza Theatre in Downtown Garland, featuring two screenings of student films to help them build academic connections with their peers and the local community.

item.title: The most dangerous states for solo travelers in America — Is Texas on the list?
item.description: A new analysis ranked all 50 states on safety indicators, listing which states are safest (and most dangerous) for solo travelers.

item.title: Veolia Texas Open to kick off PPA tour in McKinney 2026
item.description: The Veolia Texas Open will return to The Courts of McKinney from March 9-15, featuring professional pickleball players competing for gold and PPA points, with amateur players also allowed to register.
